body:
**Docstring/doc review**

Brings the docs and docstrings into compliance with the CliMA developer guides and fixes a GPU test failure. No source logic changes; src/ edits are docstrings only.

Docstrings (src/RootSolvers.jl): corrected and reformatted for dev-guide compliance; added # Returns sections and documented find_zero's failure, tolerance, and scalar/real scope semantics.
Docs (GettingStarted.md, index.md): fixed typos and reduced redundancy across README/index/Getting-Started.

**Dev-guides integration**
- Vendored [CliMA/DeveloperGuides](https://github.com/CliMA/DeveloperGuides) as a git subtree under docs/dev-guides/, with a monthly auto-update workflow, an AGENTS.md, and a README pointer.
- Remove stale untracked `docs/build/` (already gitignored).

**Tests**

* GPU tests (test/runtests.jl): skip NewtonsMethodAD on the sin problem on GPU — ForwardDiff's sin(::Dual) lowers to CUDA's device sincos, whose Ref allocation currently fails GPU codegen under GPUCompiler (upstream limitation). CPU still covers this case; all other problems/methods are unaffected.
title: Improves documentation; vendors dev-guides
